outcome: Length of stay at hospital (>3 days)
Admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: Pregnant women with and without kidney disease (778 in each group) from an integrated health care delivery system, data from 2000-2013
finding: Kidney disease in pregnancy is independently associated with adverse maternal and fetal outcomes, including increased odds of preterm delivery, cesarean delivery, low birth weight, and neonatal intensive care unit admission or infant death.
